hook_line: SATSURE RAISES 600 MILLION RUPEES FROM GOVERNMENT-BACKED SPACE FUND

hook_stat.sub: SatSure's post-money valuation in its ongoing Series B round

stats.label: Raised from the Antariksh Venture Capital Fund
Size of SatSure's ongoing Series B round
Planned launch year for SatSure's satellite imaging payloads

diaspora_bullets: The 16 billion rupee Antariksh fund is anchored by IN-SPACe, India's private space sector regulator
SatSure's named customers include HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, ITC and Bayer
news_summary: Bengaluru-based SatSure has raised 600 million rupees ($7 million) from the Antariksh Venture Capital Fund as part of an ongoing 2 billion rupee Series B round that values the satellite-data company at 8.7 billion rupees post-money.
payoff: The Series B is expected to close by December 2026, and the satellite imaging payloads the money is preparing are slated for launch in 2027.
